=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md
  Line or code reference: Step 1 "Resolve the plan doc." tail ("**Issue-mode resume cleanup:** ... run the [Zombie-checker cleanup](#zombie-checker-cleanup) now, right after this read and before step 2.")
  Problem: The previous round's BLOCKER — the Step 0 bullet deferred the issue-mode cleanup with the text "once step 1 has read the plan" but Step 1 never invoked it, so an unattended session could walk straight from Step 0 into Step 2 without ever running the cleanup. That is fixed in the current diff: Step 1 now carries the operational hook, so a `/reclarify` resume reaches a `Read` of the plan, the header is checked for `Source issue:`, and the cleanup runs immediately before Step 2. The zombie-checker cleanup header at line 187/192 of both files now states "An issue-mode resume without a `— resume.` block runs it at the end of step 1 instead, because it needs the plan header's `Source issue:` line:", so the section header no longer contradicts the new trigger.
  Why it fails at runtime: With Step 1's hook in place, an unattended `/reclarify` resume reads the plan and then archives the stopped `… — blocked on issue` session before any further progress. Without the hook, the cleanup would still be skipped and the bug the PR is meant to fix would persist.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: The PR description's "Step 0: an issue-mode resume without a `— resume.` block now runs the Zombie-checker cleanup too" is now technically satisfied because the cleanup fires on issue-mode resume (the operational hook lives in Step 1, not Step 0). The intent — "the cleanup actually runs" — is met. The description wording is slightly imprecise about which step fires the cleanup, but no runtime gap exists.
  Expected change site: PR description
  Evidence of absence: N/A (resolved in place via the Step 1 hook)
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Requirement: When a plan lacks a `Source issue:` line, the cleanup should log/report that it was skipped so an operator can distinguish an intentional no-op from cleanup that silently failed. Round 1 left this as NIT (minimax, qwen); the current diff still relies on the operator reading the negative predicate of the Step 1 trigger ("when the plan header carries a `Source issue:` line … run the [Zombie-checker cleanup](#zombie-checker-cleanup) now") and does not add a `Zombie checkers archived: 0, plus stopped stage sessions archived: 0 in issue mode (skip: no Source issue header)` log line. A purely defensive, low-risk addition; not load-bearing.
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (Issue Mode → Stops / Zombie-checker cleanup section) and the workflow-templates twin
  Evidence of absence: Step 1 trigger predicate is silent on a missing `Source issue:` line; cleanup report line at the end of the cleanup section only fires when `m` is computable.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
